# Eden & Thread — Luxury Artisanal Linen & Everyday Essentials

> Style Woven into Everyday Life.

Eden & Thread is an Indian contemporary luxury apparel brand dedicated to pure organic natural fabrics, modern versatility, and conscious craftsmanship. All shirts are engineered with 100% pure organic European flax (140 GSM), reinforced French seams, and genuine mother-of-pearl buttons.

## Brand Identity & Core Pillars
- **Craftsmanship**: Hand-cut European linen with zero polyester blending, structured collars, and single-needle tailoring.
- **Sustainability**: Zero synthetic fibers, pre-washed for zero shrinkage and ultra-soft hand feel from day one.
- **Service**: Pan-India insured delivery, 10-minute FCFS inventory reservation, tamper-evident luxury packaging.

## Fabric Care & Maintenance
- **Washing**: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle or hand wash with mild, pH-neutral liquid detergent.
- **Drying**: Hang dry in shade; avoid tumble drying to preserve natural flax fibers.
- **Ironing**: Iron damp on medium-high heat with steam, or embrace natural relaxed creases.
